sections.title: Admission Workflow
sections.content: Welcome to Bhaktivedanta Hospital & Research Institute. Our admission desk assists patients and families with seamless inpatient admission.

items.text: General Ward, Twin Sharing Semi-Private, and Single Private Deluxe room options
One designated attendant pass provided per admitted patient
24/7 central nurse call station and dedicated resident doctor coverage
Nutritious pure vegetarian meals planned by certified clinical dietitians
Daily housekeeping and rigorous hospital infection control protocols

tabs.title: Accommodation
tabs.content: Our inpatient accommodations are designed to provide a quiet, clean, and spiritually uplifting environment for speedy recovery.

sections.title: Deluxe Room
sections.content: Spacious single-occupancy air-conditioned private room with attached bathroom, patient entertainment TV, attendant couch, and personalized dietary service.

sections.title: AC Triple Sharing
sections.content: Air-conditioned room shared by three patients with individual privacy curtains, central nurse call system, and dedicated bedside locker facilities.

sections.title: AC Twin Sharing
sections.content: Semi-private air-conditioned room shared between two patients with privacy partitions, attendant seating, and television.

sections.title: AC Multiple Sharing
sections.content: Comfortable, sanitized general ward setting with air conditioning, centralized oxygen/suction ports, and 24/7 nursing station monitoring.

sections.title: AC First Class
sections.content: Individual private room with air conditioning, attached washroom, sofa for attendant, and priority doctor rounds.

sections.title: Suite
sections.content: Premium healthcare suite comprising a patient recovery room, separate attendant living lounge, dining area, refrigerator, and dedicated nurse attention.

sections.title: Premium
sections.content: Top-tier inpatient accommodations with upgraded amenities, peaceful ambiance, and personalized care coordination.

steps.title: Pre-Authorization Request
steps.description: Submit TPA / Health Insurance card and pre-authorization request form 48 hours prior for planned admission, or within 24 hours of emergency admission.

steps.title: Insurer Approval
steps.description: TPA/Insurance provider verifies coverage and sends initial approval amount.

steps.title: Final Bill Settlement
steps.description: Upon discharge, final bill and medical records are sent to TPA for final authorization.

tabs.title: Billing
tabs.content: The TPA and Insurance Helpdesk facilitates pre-authorization and cashless claim processing for empanelled insurance providers.

sections.title: Charges for Indoor Patients
sections.content: Inpatient room tariffs, consultant visit fees, investigation charges, and nursing care are billed as per standardized hospital tariff schedules based on the chosen room category.

sections.title: Mode of Payment
sections.content: Payments can be made via UPI, Debit/Credit Cards, Net Banking, Demand Drafts, Cash (as per statutory limits), or cashless authorization through empanelled TPAs and insurance partners.

sections.title: Transfer of Patient
sections.content: When a patient transfers from one room category to another (e.g. Ward to ICU or Single Room to Deluxe), applicable billing tariffs transition from the effective time of transfer as per hospital policy.

sections.title: Refund
sections.content: Any excess advance deposit remaining after final bill settlement is processed for refund to the original payment mode or bank account within statutory banking timelines.
